deal.name: Lumilens
deal.lead_investors: Atreides Management, Bain Capital Ventures, Meritech, Seligman Ventures, Spark Capital (co-leads)

subcategories.label: Lead tier
subcategories.finding: Tier 1 co-leads: Bain Capital Ventures, Spark Capital, Meritech (businesswire).

subcategories.label: New vs re-up
subcategories.finding: 4 of 5 co-leads new; Spark Capital re-upped from Series B.

subcategories.label: Stage fit
subcategories.finding: Clean oversubscribed Series C, 5 co-leads + 15+ investors (multiple sources).

subcategories.label: Domain-strategic
subcategories.finding: Leads are financial VCs; Qualcomm Ventures participates but doesn't lead.

subcategories.label: Lead conviction
subcategories.finding: Gavin Baker (Atreides) and Navin Chaddha (Mayfield) personally quoted, high conviction.

subcategories.label: Institutional momentum
subcategories.finding: Mayfield: 'partnered... third time,' invested every round since seed (optics.org).

subcategories.label: Existing Tier 1
subcategories.finding: Mayfield (seed) and Spark Capital (Series B) both Tier 1, confirmed.

subcategories.label: Timing/motivation
subcategories.finding: Opportunistic: shipping product, multi-billion customer deal, 20+ investor round.

params.evidence: Multiple confirmed Tier 1 new-money co-leads (Bain Capital Ventures, Meritech, Atreides, Seligman) alongside a Spark Capital re-up, strong institutional momentum, opportunistic oversubscribed Series C.

subcategories.label: Prior exit
subcategories.finding: CEO Singla: Contrail→Juniper 2012, Volterra→F5 ~$500M 2021 (Tracxn, SDxCentral).

subcategories.label: Domain authority
subcategories.finding: CTO Ted Schmidt pioneered Juniper's silicon photonics (Aurrion), ex-Lumentum (SDxCentral).

subcategories.label: Team complement
subcategories.finding: CEO, photonics CTO, VP Products/Ops/India — clean technical/GTM/ops coverage.

subcategories.label: Recruiting power (as in team growth)
subcategories.finding: 108 employees in ~2 yrs; hires from Cisco/Juniper/Meta/Lumentum (Revelio, press).

subcategories.label: Public presence
subcategories.finding: Regular press coverage, Mayfield founder-story feature; no conference talks found.

subcategories.label: Integrity
subcategories.finding: No red flags across many sources; no deep background check possible.

params.evidence: Elite serial founder (2 exits, ~$500M+), deep-photonics CTO, full functional coverage, fast senior hiring; no integrity concerns found.

subcategories.label: Ownership of models
subcategories.finding: Photonics hardware company; no proprietary AI model or fine-tune found.

subcategories.label: Data flywheel / Recurssion
subcategories.finding: No evidence of usage data feeding back into product (none found).

params.evidence: Lumilens is optical/photonics infrastructure serving AI data centers, not an AI-model company — no proprietary model or data flywheel identified anywhere in public sources.

subcategories.label: Just assume they are good (unless there's something public)
subcategories.finding: No public evidence on access terms; assume standard 0/0/10.

params.evidence: No public information found on how access to this round is being sold; default to standard assumed terms per policy.

subcategories.label: Revenue/growth
subcategories.finding: No disclosed revenue; product just began shipping in 2026 (siliconangle).

subcategories.label: NDR
subcategories.finding: Not disclosed; hardware supply model, no NDR data available (none found).

subcategories.label: Margins/unit econ
subcategories.finding: Not disclosed; no LTV/CAC or margin data published (none found).

subcategories.label: Burn/runway
subcategories.finding: Not disclosed; $900M raised implies strong capitalization, burn unclear (none found).

subcategories.label: Customer concentration
subcategories.finding: Sole disclosed customer: one hyperscaler's multi-billion-dollar agreement (businesswire, X/OSINT).

subcategories.label: Pref stack
subcategories.finding: Not disclosed; cap-table pref structure unknown (none found).

subcategories.label: Moat durability
subcategories.finding: Proprietary LumiCore/interposer manufacturing IP; crowded field (Ayar Labs, Celestial AI).

subcategories.label: Market/TAM
subcategories.finding: AI optics venture-scale; scale-up+scale-out expansion already in motion (optics.org).

subcategories.label: Valuation vs comps
subcategories.finding: [NOT PUBLIC]: no revenue multiple; comps (Ayar Labs $3.75B) also undisclosed.

subcategories.label: Sector risk
subcategories.finding: Structural GPU-scaling demand, but hyperscaler in-house photonics is a risk.

params.evidence: Fundamentals are largely undisclosed at this pre-revenue-disclosure stage; real signal is a crowded but venture-scale market, real manufacturing moat, and single named hyperscaler customer risk.

subcategories.label: Entry multiple
subcategories.finding: Cannot assess — no revenue disclosed to benchmark $5.51B valuation.

subcategories.label: Base-case MOIC
subcategories.finding: Insufficient data to model MOIC without revenue/growth figures (none found).

subcategories.label: Exit path
subcategories.finding: Comparable precedent: Celestial AI acquired by Marvell for $3.25B (2026).

subcategories.label: Dilution
subcategories.finding: Not attempted; no data to model future dilution rounds (none found).

subcategories.label: Time to liquidity
subcategories.finding: Unmodeled; private company, no IPO timeline disclosed (Forge/Caplight track only).

subcategories.label: Downside protection
subcategories.finding: Terms/liq pref undisclosed for this round (none found).

subcategories.label: Exit multiples
subcategories.finding: Anchored to Celestial AI/Marvell $3.25B deal, same subsector precedent.

subcategories.label: Secondary demand
subcategories.finding: Tracked on Forge and Caplight; not confirmed on Setter 30 list.

params.evidence: Return potential is hard to model given no disclosed revenue, but a genuinely comparable exit precedent exists (Celestial AI/Marvell $3.25B) and real secondary-market tracking interest.

model_output.rationale: Round dynamics fit ID8's new-money Tier-1 thesis (4 of 5 co-leads new) and the founder has two prior exits. But AI is not structural — Lumilens is optical/photonics hardware for AI data centers, not an AI-moat company, breaking the mandate.
